evidence.note: Dozens of 1 px light-grey lines fan from small agent-run dots to the package mirror; thin hairlines that compression would smear or erase.
At the small size the agent-run dots shrink to a few pixels and the grey fan lines become faint hairlines on a pale panel.
The 'PUBLIC INTERNET' zone label and globe icon are very light grey on white, low contrast; the mirror-to-internet arrow is a faint thin line.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is small (about 12 px) and faint grey; hard to read once compressed.
Title, timeline text and callout text are large and dark; these parts would survive compression.

rationale: Title, timeline and callouts use generous, high-contrast type, but the central diagram relies on many 1 px grey hairlines and tiny dots. The 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is small faint text, worst at 1288x598. Both match the fail descriptor (hairlines, small faint text), not 'nothing compression would erase'.
